# Necklace of Adaptation (`magic-items:necklace-of-adaptation`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.
